options.prompt: Create realistic, production-quality UI design for a Chinese personal Agent desktop workbench powered by DeepSeek Harness. TARGET 1440 x 1024. Date anchor 2026-09-11. Single focused primary screen, not a feature inventory or marketing page. Clear hierarchy, strong readable Chinese typography (14-16 px body), generous purposeful spacing, restrained neutral office-software aesthetics. Reference attached image is Claude official screenshot: use ONLY its calm surfaces, restrained controls and side-by-side workspace convention, not its browser content or branded logo. Also use Codex documented project-organized task navigation as layout inspiration. Product brand text "工作台", not Claude or Codex. A native-feeling desktop application, no outer browser chrome, no surrounding device scene. Left sidebar has 首页, 能力广场, Harness 设置, 知识库, 协同; bottom account "我的账号 · 本地账号". Home MUST visibly include BOTH a conversational task composer AND a desktop-like object area containing folders, task shortcuts and document artifacts. Exactly one primary action to start or continue real work. Include small unobtrusive label "交互演示" in app chrome. Sample project "个人工作台", task "整理产品方案与下一步行动", artifact "产品方案.md". Demonstrate the main workflow without charts, business metrics, promotional cards or unrelated features. No cards inside cards. Use spacing and thin dividers before border boxes, sparse shadows. No invented metrics or busy badges. App text Chinese, headings concise. Focus area and objects should be plausible interaction targets for later clickable implementation. Keep all content within viewport, do not clip or warp. One concept only per image, no numeric option label. Direction name: "安静的工作桌". Warm off-white #faf9f6 primary canvas, stone sidebar #f1f0ec, near-black typography, muted terracotta accent only on start action. 220px sidebar. Wide calm home canvas with 32px title "今天，想完成什么？" and a spacious task composer in its upper third. Below: "我的桌面" simple toolbar and two loose rows of familiar folder/file/task icons with labels, subtle grouping labels "项目" and "最近成果", not dashboard tiles. A slim right details pane 310px shows the selected project, 2 recent tasks, and one small context scope list. Productive mature desktop tool. Lots of breathing room. Prioritize immediately starting a task while keeping files and work visible.
